title: What’s one feature you added to your trading system that saved you from a costly mistake?
author: TheImperfectAlgo
selftext:
I’ve been improving my own automated trading system, and I’ve realized the best features aren’t the ones that make more money they’re the ones that prevent expensive mistakes.

Things like:

Daily loss limits  
Kill switches  
Position reconciliation  
Slippage monitoring  
Audit logs

I’m curious what feature ended up saving you the most money or prevented a disaster in production.

It doesn’t have to be AI related just something you wouldn’t build a trading system without anymore.

comments.author: Ok-Draft2744
comments.body:
Stop loss, usually hard code rather than prompt

Instructing my AI bot to exit if its thesis is invalidates. Tends to stop losses before they hit the stops

Using some sort of EMA to prevent entries, or trigger exits

I find that poor entries lose more than anything else
